name: reception-ai-root
description: ReceptionAI: A virtual AI receptionist for small businesses

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "client,server" -c "pink,lavender" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.db:setup: npx prisma migrate dev --name init && npx prisma db seed
scripts.build:client: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.build:server: npm install --prefix server && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
